explanation: Retrospective detector of being inside an extended enumerative or structured passage: it fires on the connective or entry-initial piece (of/at/with/in, a list quantity, or the first subword of a proper, technical, code, or foreign term such as Ed-/Ad-/lib/Graduate) only when the preceding tens of tokens establish repeated parallel entries (dash-led lists, recipe lines, schedules with repeated headings, import blocks, bibliographies, articles); the same title, institution, pairing, or import clause in an isolated single sentence stays near zero (~0.3-1.6), and long plain prose gives at most weak firing (~2.9) on common function words. Its output direction is nearly orthogonal to the vocabulary (Jacobian-lens list incoherent, kurtosis 3.3), so it reads out accumulated structured context rather than preparing a specific upcoming token.
